    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Accident
    Lane blockage at a fixed X.
    Car
    A car: a specific type of vehicle that can seek parking and has various driving parameters.
    EmergencyVehicle
    Ambulance / police / fire truck.
    FxRenderSmokeTest
    Framework-free rendering check for the JavaFX street canvas (the FX analog of the Swing RenderSmokeTest).
    Lane
    One horizontal lane of a fixed length (in cells).
    Main
    Entry point for the program.
    Movable
    Simple idea: Anything that can move or be stopped on the street.
    ParkingSpot
    A single curb-side parking spot.
    PoliceVehicle
    Visible Phase 2 patrol car.
    Reservable
    Something that can be reserved ahead of time, then released or consumed.
    ScenarioPlan
    A recorded traffic scenario: the exact ordered sequence of car arrivals (each with its driver properties) and emergency arrivals produced by a Phase 1 run.
    ScenarioPlan.CarArrival
    One recorded car arrival: when it spawned plus its intrinsic properties.
    Simulation
    Fixed-step simulation engine.
    StatisticsTracker
    Records per-cycle KPIs.
    Street
    The full street: a collection of lanes plus a row of parking spots down one side.
    TrafficController
    Phase 2 "brain" for managed parking.
    TrafficFxApp
    JavaFX front end for the roadside-parking simulation.
    Vehicle
    Abstract base for everything that drives on the street.
